CustomField.formula: ( /* END in minutes */ (MOD(VALUE(LEFT(TEXT(EndTime__c), 2)), 12) * 60) + VALUE(MID(TEXT(EndTime__c), 4, 2)) + IF(RIGHT(TEXT(EndTime__c), 2) = "PM", 720, 0) ) - ( /* START in minutes */ (MOD(VALUE(LEFT(TEXT(StartTime__c), 2)), 12) * 60) + VALUE(MID(TEXT(StartTime__c), 4, 2)) + IF(RIGHT(TEXT(StartTime__c), 2) = "PM", 720, 0) )
CustomField.label: Scheduled Minutes
